channel.title: Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly (masslawyersweekly.com)

item.title: Trump administration won’t let student deported to Honduras return
item.description: The Trump administration says it will not return a Babson College student deported to Honduras despite a court order, calling the judge’s proposal unfeasible.

item.title: Former federal judge linked to misconduct inquiry
item.description: Court records reveal a misconduct inquiry into former U.S. District Court Judge Mark Wolf tied to a former law clerk.

item.title: 5th Circuit upholds Trump’s immigration detention policy
item.description: The 5th Circuit upheld the Trump administration’s policy requiring mandatory immigration detention without bond, affecting thousands of detainees in Texas and Louisiana.

item.title: Police academy staff indicted in connection with death of trooper recruit
item.description: Four Massachusetts State Police academy instructors face manslaughter charges in the 2024 death of recruit Enrique Delgado-Garcia during training exercises.

item.title: Habeas relief denied in SDP appeal
item.description: The Supreme Judicial Court has vacated a Superior Court order granting habeas corpus relief to a petitioner challenging his commitment as a sexually dangerous person.

item.title: Panel revives religious bias, retaliation claims vs. Hasbro
item.description: 1st Circuit revives lawsuit by Hasbro managers alleging religious discrimination and retaliation over COVID-19 vaccine exemptions they failed to receive.

item.title: Immigration judge rejects Trump effort to deport Tufts student
item.description: Boston immigration judge rejects Trump administration's attempt to deport Tufts PhD student Rumeysa Ozturk over pro-Palestinian activism and free speech claims.

item.title: Parole rates in Massachusetts on the rise
item.description: Parole rates in Massachusetts increased to 68% in 2024, with more lifers released and ongoing efforts to improve supervision and reentry services.

item.title: Auditor turns to SJC in bid for representation
item.description: Auditor Diana DiZoglio asked the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court to appoint a special assistant attorney general to represent her office in a legislative audit dispute.

item.title: Land Court issues order on public access to records
item.description: The Land Court has issued a new standing order that sets limits on remote access to some types of electronic court records.
